events.title: Gustav Vasa is elected King of Sweden
events.description: At Strängnäs the Swedish estates chose Gustav Eriksson Vasa, leader of the revolt against Danish rule, as king. He broke with Rome and laid the foundations of the Swedish state. The day is now Sweden's National Day.

events.title: George Williams founds the YMCA in London
events.description: A draper's assistant, George Williams, and eleven friends founded the Young Men's Christian Association to support young workers in the city. It spread worldwide.
events.html: A draper's assistant, George Williams, and eleven friends founded the Young Men's Christian Association to support young workers in the city. It spread worldwide.

events.title: US Marines attack at Belleau Wood
events.description: American Marines launched costly assaults on German positions west of Château-Thierry. Three weeks of fighting helped halt the German drive on Paris.
events.html: American Marines launched costly assaults on German positions west of Château-Thierry. Three weeks of fighting helped halt the German drive on Paris.

events.title: First drive-in cinema opens in New Jersey
events.description: Richard Hollingshead opened his 'Automobile Movie Theatre' at Pennsauken, near Camden. Drive-ins became a fixture of post-war American suburban life.
events.html: Richard Hollingshead opened his 'Automobile Movie Theatre' at Pennsauken, near Camden. Drive-ins became a fixture of post-war American suburban life.

events.title: Allied armies land in Normandy on D-Day
events.description: About 156,000 Allied troops landed by sea and air on the Normandy coast. The invasion opened the long-awaited second front against Germany in Western Europe.
events.html: About 156,000 Allied troops landed by sea and air on the Normandy coast. The invasion opened the long-awaited second front against Germany in Western Europe.

events.title: Alexey Pajitnov completes the first version of Tetris
events.description: Working at a Soviet Academy of Sciences computing centre in Moscow, Pajitnov finished his falling-block puzzle game. It became one of the best-selling video games in history.
